mass_kg.source: Golf V 1.9 TDI curb mass ~1.28-1.35 t by trim/body, plus driver, fuel and cargo. Replace with a weighbridge figure to shrink the dominant uncertainty.

cda_m2.source: Golf V Cd ~0.32 x frontal area ~2.2 m2; +/-7 % for mirrors, roof, ride height.

crr.source: Passenger-car tyres on asphalt, warm, typical label classes B-E.

eta_driveline.source: Manual FWD transaxle incl. CV joints, direct/indirect gears 3-4.

inertia_engine_kgm2.source: 1.9 TDI crank train + dual-mass flywheel + clutch.

inertia_wheels_kgm2.source: Four 16" wheel/tyre assemblies incl. discs and drive shafts.

wheel_radius_m.source: 205/55 R16 dynamic rolling radius; only used for wheel inertia term.

ambient_temp_k.source: Ambient temperature on 2026-09-16 not logged (IAT is post-intercooler).

grade_frac.source: Road gradient not logged. +/-1.5 % mean grade over a pull. Dominant for absolute torque.

speed_scale.source: OBD PID 0x0D vs true speed; tyre wear and ECU speed scaling.

lhv_j_kg.source: EN 590 diesel lower heating value, typical 42.6-43.1 MJ/kg.

afr_stoich.source: Diesel stoichiometric air/fuel mass ratio ~14.5 (composition dependent).

eta_brake_full_load.source: Brake efficiency of a small turbo-DI diesel near full load (BSFC ~205-245 g/kWh). Not measured on this engine.

coolant_c_for_friction.source: Coolant 91 C in session snapshot of 2026-09-16 logs.

charge_temp_c.source: Logged IAT 35 C was a stale snapshot (age > 8 s); WOT charge temperature bracketed.

ve_expected.source: Volumetric efficiency of an 8-valve turbo diesel referenced to manifold conditions.

maf_scale.source: True air / OBD PID 0x10 reading. Hot-film MAF sensors drift low with age; apparent VE 0.71-0.94 from these logs cannot separate sensor drift from real VE. Asymmetric on purpose.

smoke_axis_check.note: FlMng_pIATCorr_MAP axis input is FlMng_pBPAPCorr_mp; identity with logged MAP is assumed (both are boost pressure in hPa abs).

findings.text: Commanded fuel exceeds what the measured air can burn cleanly (median lambda < 1.10).
Measured torque is more than 15 % below the energy model of the commanded fuel.
where: G3 2250 rpm: road 214 [180-247] Nm vs fuel model 304 Nm
G3 3500 rpm: road 231 [203-266] Nm vs fuel model 297 Nm
G4 3000 rpm: road 252 [218-288] Nm vs fuel model 296 Nm
G4 3250 rpm: road 238 [204-279] Nm vs fuel model 296 Nm
G4 3500 rpm: road 232 [200-272] Nm vs fuel model 296 Nm
G4 3750 rpm: road 207 [178-241] Nm vs fuel model 296 Nm
G4 4000 rpm: road 183 [156-212] Nm vs fuel model 296 Nm

candidate_plan.lambda_target_source: median commanded-fuel lambda of gear-4 pulls at (2000, 2250, 2500) rpm (measured air, current smoke map)

cells.formula: q = max(air_mg_stroke / (lambda_target * 14.5), interpolation constraint of logged bins)
q = max(air_mg_stroke / (lambda_target * 14.5), interpolation constraint of logged bins)

candidate_plan.validation_metric: gear-4 WOT 2750-4000 rpm: road torque P50 must not fall by more than the pull-to-pull spread; logged IQ (VCDS) must equal the new smoke column within 1 mg where it binds
abort_criteria: road torque P50 at any 3000-3750 rpm bin drops > 15 Nm vs this analysis
visible smoke unchanged AND logged IQ already below the new cap (cap had no effect)
